questions.question:
[지문]
A My name is Hana. Nice to meet you.
B Hi, I'm Jihun. ⓐNice to meet you, too.
A I like P.E. class. (A)너는 어때, Jihun?
B I like P.E. class, too.

다음 중 위 (A)의 우리말과 일치하는 표현을 고르면?
questions.explanation: (A) 너는 어때, Jihun?은 상대방에 대해 묻는 표현으로 'How about you?'가 적절합니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
A My name is Hana. Nice to meet you.
B Hi, I'm Jihun. ⓐNice to meet you, too.

위 밑줄 친 ⓐ와 바꿔 쓸 수 없는 표현은?
questions.explanation: 'Nice to meet you, too'와 바꿔 쓸 수 있는 표현은 'Me, too', 'Likewise', 'Same here', 'Happy to meet you, too' 등입니다. 'That's right'는 동의나 확인의 의미로 문맥에 맞지 않습니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Let me introduce my friend to you. Her name ⓐ_____ Lee Aram. Her birthday ⓑ_____ March 8. She ⓒ_____ pizza. Her favorite pizza ⓓ_____ cheese pizza. She ⓔ_____ hip-hop. Her favorite song ⓕ_____ "For You."

다음 빈칸 ⓐ~ⓕ에 알맞은 말을 적절하게 완성할 때, 'be동사'가 들어가기에 적절한 빈칸의 개수는?
questions.explanation: be동사가 들어갈 빈칸: ⓐ is (name is), ⓑ is (birthday is), ⓓ is (favorite pizza is). 따라서 3개입니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Mystery Bag
Hello, everyone. My name is Jiho. I'm a great dancer. I ⓐalways carry this item. It's not big, but ⓑit makes a big sound. What is it?
Yes, it's my Bluetooth speaker. With this speaker, ⓒevery places are my stage. I often dance for my grandmother. She is my big fan.
Hello, I'm Mina. My favorite sport is baseball. I'm a catcher, so ⓓthis item is very important for me. Thanks to this, my hand is safe. ⓔWhat is it?
That's right! It's my glove. I play baseball with my friends every day. Come and join us!

밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓒ 'every places are'는 어법상 틀렸습니다. 'every place is'로 수정해야 합니다. every는 단수형을 사용하므로 'place'는 단수이고 be동사는 'is'여야 합니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Hi, I'm Kate. Look at my mystery bag. What's in the bag? My little friend is in this bag. It's small, and it sometimes flies. I love it a lot, but my brother doesn't like it. What is it?
Ta-da! It's a beetle. Its name is Beeti. Are you afraid of it? Look! It's so cute.

다음 글의 내용과 각 진술이 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 쓴 것으로 옳은 것은?
- Kate thinks Beeti is cute. ______
- Beeti never flies. ______
- Kate has a brother. ______
questions.explanation: 첫 번째: 'Look! It's so cute'에서 Kate가 귀엽다고 생각함 (T). 두 번째: 'it sometimes flies'이므로 항상 날지 않음 (F). 세 번째: 'my brother doesn't like it'에서 형제가 있음 (T).

questions.question:
[지문]
Hello, everyone. My name (a)______ Jiho. I'm a great dancer. I always carry this item. It's not big, but it (b)______ a big sound. What is it?
Yes, it's my Bluetooth speaker. With this speaker, every place (c)______ my stage. I often dance for my grandmother. She is my big fan.
Hello, I'm Mina. My favorite sport is baseball. I'm a catcher, so this item (d)______ very important for me. Thanks to this, my hand is safe. What (e)______ it?
That's right! It's my glove. I play baseball with my friends every day. Come and join us!

다음 글의 (a)~(e)에 들어갈 말이 나머지와 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: (a) is, (b) makes, (c) is, (d) is는 모두 be동사이거나 일반동사 makes입니다. (e) 'What is it?'에서는 be동사 'is'가 아닌 문장 구조가 다릅니다. (e)에는 be동사 'is'가 들어갑니다.

questions.question:
다음 문장의 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 다른 하나는? (단, 현재시제를 사용할 것)
① What _____ he do?
② She _____ not talk much.
③ He always _____ his best.
④ Sarah _____ not look good.
⑤ Why _____ they love sports?
questions.explanation: ①does (3인칭 단수 의문문), ②does (does not = doesn't), ④does (does not = doesn't), ⑤do (3인칭 복수)의 조동사가 필요합니다. ③은 'does'가 아닌 일반동사 'does'가 필요하지 않고, 'does'가 들어가면 'He always does his best'가 되어 다른 구조입니다.

options: ② Are you afraid of it?
questions.question:
[지문]
Ta-da! It's a beetle.

Hi, I'm Kate. Look at my mystery bag. What's in the bag? My little friend is in this bag. It's small, and it sometimes flies. I love it a lot, but my brother doesn't like it. What is it?

다음 주어진 문장이 들어갈 곳으로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: 문맥상 'What is it?'의 답변으로 'Ta-da! It's a beetle.'이 온 후, 곤충의 이름을 소개하는 'Its name is Beeti.'가 따라야 합니다.

options: ② 'My little friend is in this bag.' 앞
③ 'It's small, and it sometimes flies.' 앞
questions.question:
[지문]
Mystery Bag
This is Mr. Kim's English class. His students introduce their favorite things in mystery bags.

Hi, I'm Kate. Look at my mystery bag. My little friend is in this bag. It's small, and it sometimes flies. I love it a lot, but my brother doesn't like it. What is it?

Ta-da! It's a beetle. Its name is Beeti. Are you afraid of it? Look! It's so cute.

다음 주어진 문장이 들어갈 곳으로 가장 적절한 것은?
What's in the bag?
questions.explanation: Kate가 'Look at my mystery bag'이라고 말한 후, 자신이 답하는 형식으로 'What's in the bag?'이 들어가야 자연스러운 흐름입니다.

options: ① Carl is from San Diego. (Carl은 San Diego에 살고 있다.)
② This is my best friend, Carl. (이 사람은 나의 사촌, Carl이다.)
③ Carl and I are best friends. (Carl과 나는 가장 친한 친구다.)
④ I go to Hanguk Middle School. (나는 한국 중학교에 가고 싶다.)
⑤ We are not in the same class. (우리는 같은 반이다.)
questions.question: 다음 주어진 영어 문장과 일치하도록 바르게 해석된 문장은?
questions.explanation: ① is from = ~에서 왔다 (정확한 표현), ② best friend = 가장 친한 친구 (오류: 사촌이 아님), ③ are best friends = 가장 친한 친구다 (정확함), ④ go to = 다니다 (오류: 가고 싶다가 아님), ⑤ are not = ~가 아니다 (오류: 같은 반이 맞음).

questions.question:
[지문]
W: Let me introduce my friend to you. Her name ⓐ_____ Lee Aram. Her birthday ⓑ_____ March 8. She likes pizza. Her favorite pizza ⓒ_____ cheese pizza. She ⓓ_____ hip-hop. Her favorite song ⓔ_____ "For You."

빈칸 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 들어갈 말이 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ is (name is), ⓑ is (birthday is), ⓒ is (favorite pizza is), ⓔ is (favorite song is)는 모두 be동사입니다. ⓓ는 'She _____ hip-hop'으로 일반동사 'likes'가 들어가야 하므로 다릅니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Hi, I'm Kate. Look at my mystery bag. What's in the bag? My little friend is in this bag. It's small, and it sometimes flies. I love it a lot, but my brother doesn't like it. What is it?
Ta-da! It's a beetle. Its name is Beeti. Are you afraid of it? Look! It's so cute.

다음 글을 요약할 때, 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 알맞게 짝지어진 것은?
Kate is introducing her little friend, Beeti. Beeti is a (A) ______. She loves it a lot, but her brother (B) _____ it.
questions.explanation: 본문에서 'It's a beetle'이라고 명시되었고, 'my brother doesn't like it'에서 형이 싫어한다고 했으므로 (A) beetle, (B) doesn't like이 정답입니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Mystery Bag
This is Mr. Kim's English class. His students introduce their favorite things in mystery bags.
Hello, everyone. My name is Jiho. I'm a great dancer. I always carry this item. It's not big, but it makes a big sound. What is it?
Yes, it's my Bluetooth speaker. With this speaker, every place is my stage. I often dance for my grandmother. She is my big fan.

Jiho is introducing his favorite item, Bluetooth speaker. Its size is ⓐ _______, but it makes a powerful sound. He can dance everywhere with this speaker, and his grandmother ⓑ ________ Jiho's dance.

다음 글을 요약할 때, 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 알맞게 짝지어진 것은?
questions.explanation: 본문에서 'It's not big'이고 'She is my big fan'이라고 했으므로 (A) small, (B) likes가 정답입니다.

options: 도진: It is Jiho's favorite item.
수진: It can make a big sound.
사라: His grandmother doesn't like it.
questions.question:
[지문]
Mystery Bag
This is Mr. Kim's English class. His students introduce their favorite things in mystery bags.
Hello, everyone. My name is Jiho. I'm a great dancer. I always carry this item. It's not big, but it makes a big sound. What is it?
Yes, it's ⓐ my Bluetooth speaker. With this speaker, every place is my stage. I often dance for my grandmother. She is my big fan.

다음 글에 밑줄 친 ⓐ에 대해 올바르게 설명하고 있지 않은 학생은?
questions.explanation: 본문에서 'I always carry this item'(나라-○), 'I'm a great dancer'(도진-○), 'It's not big'(미나-○), 'makes a big sound'(수진-○)는 모두 맞습니다. 그러나 'She is my big fan'이므로 할머니는 좋아하신다(사라-×)는 설명이 틀렸습니다.

options: ① My favorite sport is baseball.
② I'm a catcher, so this item is very important for me.
③ When I hit a home run, it makes me excited!
④ Thanks to this, my hand is safe.
questions.question:
[지문]
Hello, I'm Mina. My favorite sport is baseball. I'm a catcher, so this item is very important for me. When I hit a home run, it makes me excited! Thanks to this, my hand is safe. What is it?
That's right! It's my glove. I play baseball with my friends every day. Come and join us!

다음 글에서 전체 흐름과 관계가 없는 문장은?
questions.explanation: 'When I hit a home run, it makes me excited!'는 장갑(glove)과의 관계가 명확하지 않습니다. 나머지 문장들은 모두 선수로서 장갑의 중요성을 설명하고 있습니다.

options: ⑤ He does not like birds.
questions.question:
다음 밑줄 친 부분의 의미가 <보기>와 다른 경우는? (*답 2개)
<보기> I like math.

① It works like this.
② What do you like?
③ Like father, like son.
④ I like classical music.
⑤ He does not like birds.
questions.explanation: <보기>의 'like'는 '좋아하다'는 뜻입니다. ① 'like'는 '~처럼'의 의미이고, ③ 'like'도 '~처럼'의 의미입니다. ②④⑤의 'like'는 모두 '좋아하다'는 의미입니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Let me introduce my friend to you. Her name is Lee Aram. Her birthday is March 8. She likes pizza. Her favorite pizza is cheese pizza. She loves hip-hop. Her favorite song is "For You."

다음 글을 읽고 답할 수 없는 질문은?
questions.explanation: 글에서 친구의 이름(Lee Aram), 좋아하는 것(피자), 가장 좋아하는 피자(치즈피자), 가장 좋아하는 노래('For You')에 대해 언급되어 있으나, 친구가 어디에서 태어났는지(Where was my friend born?)에 대한 정보는 없다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Hi, I'm Kate. Look at my mystery bag. What's in the bag? My little friend is in this bag. It's small, and it sometimes flies. I love it a lot, but my brother doesn't like it. What is it? Ta-da! It's a ⓐ _______. Its name is Beeti. Are you afraid of it? Look! It's so cute.

다음 글에서 빈칸 ⓐ에 들어갈 가장 알맞은 단어는?
questions.explanation: 지문에서 '작고 때로는 날기도 한다(It's small, and it sometimes flies)', '귀여워한다(It's so cute)', '이름이 Beeti'라는 단서로 보아 딱정벌레(beetle)가 정답이다.

questions.question:
[보기]
big : small

다음 중 짝지어진 단어의 관계가 <보기>와 같은 것은? (*답 2개)
questions.explanation: 보기에서 'big : small'은 반대의 의미를 가진 반의어 관계이다. 마찬가지로 반대 의미의 반의어는: (2) busy(바쁜) : free(자유로운), (5) never(절대 안 함) : always(항상)이다. (1) kind와 nice, (3) right와 correct, (4) afraid와 scared는 모두 같은 의미의 동의어이다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Hello, I'm Inho. My dream job is a tour guide, and I love a map a lot. It is a picture of the world. It shows the names of places. I always put it on my desk and study it. What is it?

<보기>는 주어진 글을 요약한 내용이다. 밑줄 친 어휘 중 적절하지 않은 것은?

<보기>
Inho's dream job is a ⓐtour ⓑguide. He puts a ⓒmap on his ⓓchair and ⓔstudies it.
questions.explanation: 원문에서 'I always put it on my desk and study it'라고 했으므로, 지도를 의자(chair) 위에 놓는다는 것은 맞지 않다. 올바른 표현은 'desk(책상)'이어야 한다. 따라서 ⓓ chair가 적절하지 않은 어휘이다.
